text.zh: 你对本地公共交通的总体评价如何？
text.en: How do you rate local public transport overall?

text.zh: 你是否支持增加公共图书馆投入？
text.en: Do you support increasing investment in public libraries?

text.zh: 你对社区绿地的数量满意吗？
text.en: Are you satisfied with the amount of green space in your community?

text.zh: 你认为远程办公的普及有益吗？
text.en: Do you consider wider adoption of remote work beneficial?

text.zh: 你是否支持扩大社区体育设施？
text.en: Do you support expanding community sports facilities?

text.zh: 你对本地垃圾分类服务满意吗？
text.en: Are you satisfied with local waste sorting services?
